Travel and exploration

Plane crash: look for the Captain Keycard in the nose

The crashed plane holds valuable loot. Search interactive containers in the nose section; a player reported finding the Captain Keycard there.

The Captain Keycard cannot be crafted. You receive one card when it appears, but not every search will yield one.

The nose is a place to find the card, not to use it. The in-game item description says it does not work in the cockpit; look for a card reader elsewhere on the plane.

Source: player report on the nose section, in-game item description, and game data; reviewed 2026-10-23.
